name: pooled
cmd: set -e; for t in 1995 1985; do t0=$((t+1)); P="{python} research/exp/span_pooled.py --out {out} --t0 $t0"; $P --tag final4 --short desk_tempho_${t}_s1_yw10_late desk_tempho_${t}_s2_yw10_late desk_tempho_${t}_s3_yw10_late desk_tempho_${t}_s4_yw10_late --long desk_tempho_${t}_s1_late desk_tempho_${t}_s2_late desk_tempho_${t}_s3_late desk_tempho_${t}_s4_late; $P --tag selected4 --short desk_tempho_${t}_s1_yw10 desk_tempho_${t}_s2_yw10 desk_tempho_${t}_s3_yw10 desk_tempho_${t}_s4_yw10 --long desk_tempho_${t}_s1 desk_tempho_${t}_s2 desk_tempho_${t}_s3 desk_tempho_${t}_s4; done
note: E032 decision: four-seed weighted minus unweighted at the final epoch (primary) and selected epoch, both start years
